Must Try Italian Restaurant in Sapa
Sep 2026 • Couples
Had a wonderful dining experience at Cucina Sapa! The food was absolutely delicious. We tried the Pesto Chicken Pasta and Four Cheese Pasta, both of which were rich, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. We ended our meal with the Crème Brûlée, which was the perfect sweet finish! 😍
A special thank you to the Manager, Thuy, for the exceptional hospitality. She continuously checked on us throughout our visit, made excellent recommendations, and ensured we had a memorable dining experience.
The combination of delicious food, warm hospitality, and attentive service made our visit truly special. Highly recommend Cucina Sapa to anyone looking for a great Italian dining experience
Read more
Written September 29, 2026
Cucina Sapa
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you so much for your wonderful and thoughtful review. We’re truly delighted to hear that you had such a memorable dining experience at Cucina Sapa and enjoyed our Pesto Chicken Pasta and Four Cheese Pasta. Your comments about the rich flavors and careful preparation are a wonderful compliment to our kitchen team.

We’re especially pleased that our Crème Brûlée provided the perfect sweet finish to your meal. We always hope that every part of the dining experience, from the first dish to dessert, leaves our guests with something special to remember.

A very special thank you for mentioning Thuy and her exceptional hospitality. We’re so happy to hear that she took the time to check on you throughout your visit, offer recommendations, and make sure everything was to your liking. We’ll certainly share your kind words with her, as recognition from our guests means a great deal to our team.

It means a lot to us that you appreciated the combination of delicious food, warm hospitality, and attentive service. Thank you again for your generous recommendation and for choosing Cucina Sapa.

We sincerely hope to welcome you back again whenever you return to Sa Pa for another memorable Italian dining experience.

Warm regards,
Tri Nguyen. (Mr)

An excellent dinner in a place already tested a year ago
Sep 2026 • Solo
Excellent Italian meal (soup and seafood pasta). I had already dined at La Cucina during a previous stay in Sapa (in November 2025). An employee explained to me that the Italian chef left to open another restaurant in Asia but he took the time to train his sous-chef for months. And the quality (fresh products, preparation, presentation) is still there. Congratulations to the whole team. Several employees like to practice their French with French-speaking customers. In short, an excellent place when you want to take a little break from the local cuisine, which is also delicious, however.

We’re delighted that you enjoyed the soup and seafood pasta, and we truly appreciate your comments about the fresh ingredients, preparation, and presentation. Our team works hard to maintain the standards and care that we want every guest to experience, and your recognition is a wonderful encouragement to our kitchen.

We’re also very pleased that you noticed the continuity in our kitchen team and the training that has taken place over time. Although our team evolves, we always place great importance on sharing knowledge, maintaining consistency, and making sure that the quality of our dishes remains at the heart of what we do.

It’s wonderful to hear that some of our team members enjoyed practicing their French with French-speaking guests as well. We love creating an environment where our staff and guests can connect beyond the meal, and these small conversations are a special part of our hospitality.

Thank you again for your continued support and for describing Cucina Sapa as a place where guests can enjoy a short Italian break while travelling through Sa Pa. We’re very happy that you continue to find us a worthwhile address, and we sincerely hope to welcome you back again on your next visit.
